2023 has 33 results and 2015 has 6, so 2023 exceeds 2015 by 27. I searched "intermittent fasting" on PubMed with the Randomized Controlled Trial article-type filter and a single-year publication date range for each year. The counts are the result totals shown on each results page.

ANSWER: 33; 6; 27
